native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 0.7, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'off', 'servo1': 0, 'servo2': 180}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. At time 0.7 seconds, the system should be in the first state of the cycle: Servo1 is at 0 degrees and moving (so LED1 is on), Servo2 is at 180 degrees and stationary (LED2 off), and LED3 is off.'}

test2: {'time': 9.0, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'on', 'led3': 'off', 'servo1': 180, 'servo2': 180}, 'description': 'After 8.3 seconds from the start (total ~9.0 seconds), Servo1 should have completed its movement to 180 degrees. Now Servo2 starts moving from 180 degrees downwards (so LED2 is on), Servo1 remains at 180 degrees (LED1 off), and LED3 is off.'}

test3: {'time': 17.0, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'on', 'servo1': 180, 'servo2': 0}, 'description': 'After another 8.3 seconds (total ~17.0 seconds), Servo2 should have reached 0 degrees. Both servos are at their target positions (180 and 0), so LED3 lights up for 2 seconds. LED1 and LED2 are off.'}

test4: {'time': 25.0, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off', 'led3': 'off', 'servo1': 0, 'servo2': 180}, 'description': 'After another 8.3 seconds (total ~25.0 seconds), the 2-second LED3 on period should have ended, and the cycle repeats from the beginning: Servo1 is at 0 degrees and moving (LED1 on), Servo2 is at 180 degrees and stationary (LED2 off), and LED3 is off.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
